normative_extracts.quote: The getBoundingClientRect() method forces a synchronous layout calculation if styles are dirty, returning a DOMRect relative to the viewport.

browser_support.notes: Built on ResizeObserver, IntersectionObserver, and getBoundingClientRect().

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: computePosition reads reference and floating DOMRects, runs collision middleware in JS, and writes translate3d() coordinates.

production_failures.symptom: Tooltip drifts away from its button during fast wheel or touch scrolling
production_failures.root_cause: Using window.scroll only misses nested overflow: auto scroll containers; JS rAF also lags async compositor scroll by 1 frame.
production_failures.mitigation: Use Floating UI autoUpdate() with ancestorScroll: true so every scrollable ancestor is observed.

production_failures.symptom: Opening 50 table-row tooltips or popovers causes a 30ms frame spike
production_failures.root_cause: Interleaving computePosition() calls per item triggers repeated forced synchronous layouts.
production_failures.mitigation: Position only the single active popover on open, and write coordinates via transform: translate3d() to skip Layout.
